description: Moves backward or forward through page navigation history using steps, a domain anchor, or a tag.

pageId.description: Page ID whose navigation history should be changed.

direction.description: Direction in which to search or move through navigation history.

domain.description: Optional hostname anchor, such as example.com; searches the nearest matching entry in the requested direction.

tag.description: Exact history tag to locate in the requested direction.

n.description: Relative number of entries; 0 means the oldest entry when going back or newest entry when going forward.

purpose.description: Describe why returning to or revisiting this navigation entry is needed for the task

pageId.description: Page ID whose history position was changed.

requestedTarget.description: History target requested by the caller.

navigationStarted.description: Whether navigation to the history target was dispatched.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

pageId.description: Page ID whose history position was changed.

requestedTarget.description: History target requested by the caller.

navigationStarted.description: Whether navigation to the history target was dispatched.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
